⚔️ Lexicon Coliseum — Real-Time PvP System

This chapter documents the Week 2 PvP networking layer added to Lexicon Coliseum: real-time player-vs-player duels using Server-Sent Events, Chess-style Elo ratings, and Firebase Firestore persistence.

Contents

  • Architecture Overview

    • SSE Event Protocol

  • REST Endpoints

  • Elo Rating Engine (modules/arena/elo.js)

    • Formula

    • Tier Divisions

  • Matchmaking (modules/arena/matchmaking.js)

  • Anti-Cheat Validation (modules/arena/anti-cheat.js)

  • Leaderboard (modules/arena/leaderboard-ui.js)

  • PvP Client (modules/arena/pvp-client.js)

  • Data Model (Firestore)

—

Architecture Overview

The PvP system uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) for server→client push and standard fetch POST calls for client→server actions. No external WebSocket package is required — the system runs on the existing Express server.

Browser Tab A                 Express Server               Browser Tab B
─────────────                 ──────────────               ─────────────
pvp-ui.js                     server.js                    pvp-ui.js
  │  Quick Match click         /api/arena/queue               │
  ├──POST /api/arena/queue ──► match pool                      │
  │                            pair when 2 players             │
  ◄── { roomCode: "APEX" } ──                                  │
  │                            SSE channels open:              │
  ├──GET /api/arena/room/APEX/stream ──────────────────────────┤
  │  word submitted             validate (anti-cheat)          │
  │                            broadcast game_state to both   │
  ◄── game_state event ───────                 ───────────────►┤
  │                            match_end → Elo update          │
  ◄── elo_update event ───────  Firestore.set(pvp_ratings)     │

SSE Event Protocol

The server broadcasts the following named SSE events to all players in a room:

Event

Payload (JSON)

Description

room_joined

{ roomId, role }

Sent on SSE connect. role is "host" or "guest".

opponent_joined

{ opponentName, roomId }

Sent to the host when the second player connects.

game_state

{ lastWord, hostHp, guestHp, chain, turnCount }

Broadcast after every valid word action.

match_end

{ winner, hostHp, guestHp }

Broadcast when a player reaches 0 HP.

heartbeat

{ ts }

Sent every 25 s to keep the SSE connection alive.

error

{ reason }

Sent on room expiry or server-side error.

REST Endpoints

Method

Path

Description

POST

/api/arena/room

Create a Private Duel room. Returns { roomCode } (4-char code).

POST

/api/arena/room/:code/join

Join a room by code. Returns { success, roomCode }.

GET

/api/arena/room/:code/stream

Open SSE stream. Query param: ?uid=<Firebase UID>.

POST

/api/arena/room/:code/action

Submit a word. Body: { word, uid }. Returns { success, word }.

POST

/api/arena/queue

Join Quick Match queue. Returns { roomCode, role, opponentName, opponentElo } if immediately paired, or { queued: true, position } if waiting.

GET

/api/arena/queue/stream

Open SSE waiting stream while queued (?uid=<Firebase UID>); emits match_found as soon as a compatible opponent joins.

POST

/api/arena/queue/leave

Leave the Quick Match queue. Body: { uid }.

GET

/api/arena/leaderboard/pvp

Fetch top 50 PvP Elo rankings from Firestore.

POST

/api/arena/match/end

Persist final Elo ratings after a match. Body includes winner/loser UIDs and new Elo values computed on the client.

—

Elo Rating Engine (modules/arena/elo.js)

The PvP ranking system uses a standard FIDE Elo formula adapted for vocabulary duels.

Formula

\[ \begin{align}\begin{aligned}E_A = \frac{1}{1 + 10^{(R_B - R_A) / 400}}\\R'_A = R_A + K \times (S_A - E_A)\end{aligned}\end{align} \]

Where:

  • \(E_A\) — expected score for player A (probability of winning)

  • \(R_A, R_B\) — current Elo ratings

  • \(K\) — K-factor: 32 for ratings below 2100, 16 for ≥ 2100

  • \(S_A\) — actual score: 1 (win), 0 (loss), 0.5 (draw)

Tier Divisions

Tier

Elo Range

Description

🥉 Bronze

0 – 1199

Starting tier for all new players (default Elo: 1200).

🥈 Silver

1200 – 1399

Consistently wins against Rookie-level bots.

🥇 Gold

1400 – 1599

Comfortable with B1/B2 CEFR vocabulary duels.

💎 Platinum

1600 – 1799

Regular C1 usage; defeats Scholar bots consistently.

💠 Diamond

1800 – 1999

Approaches Grand Inquisitor territory.

👑 Grandmaster

2000+

Elite vocabulary combatant. K-factor drops to 16 for rating stability.

—

Matchmaking (modules/arena/matchmaking.js)

Private Duel

  1. Player A calls POST /api/arena/room → receives a 4-char room code (e.g. APEX).

  2. Player A shares the code out-of-band (copy button in the UI).

  3. Player B enters the code and calls POST /api/arena/room/APEX/join.

  4. Both players open GET /api/arena/room/APEX/stream.

Quick Match

  1. Player calls POST /api/arena/queue with their uid and elo.

  2. The server checks the queue for a compatible opponent (Elo within ±200).

  3. If found → returns { roomCode } immediately and both are connected.

  4. If not found → returns { queued: true } and the client listens for a room_joined SSE event (server pushes when a match is made).

  5. After 30 seconds of waiting, the Elo constraint is relaxed and the longest-waiting player is paired with the next available opponent.

Room codes use an unambiguous character set (no I, O, 0, 1). Rooms auto-expire after 5 minutes if the second player never joins.

—

Anti-Cheat Validation (modules/arena/anti-cheat.js)

Every word submitted via POST /api/arena/room/:code/action is validated server-side before being accepted. The following rules are enforced:

Rule

Description

RATE_LIMIT

Maximum 1 word per 500 ms per player UID.

TOO_SHORT

Word must be ≥ 3 characters.

TOO_LONG

Word must be ≤ 45 characters.

INVALID_CHARS

Only lowercase alphabetic characters (a–z) are accepted.

DUPLICATE

A word already played in the current match is rejected.

CHAIN_BREAK

The word’s first letter must match the last letter of the previous word.

—

Leaderboard (modules/arena/leaderboard-ui.js)

The dual-tab leaderboard panel renders two competitive views side by side in the Coliseum lobby:

vs AI tab — Fetched from GET /api/challenge/leaderboard. Displays the top 10 single-player scores ranked by total iron-chain pull (kg).

vs Player tab — Fetched from GET /api/arena/leaderboard/pvp. Displays the top 10 PvP Elo rankings. Each row shows:

  • Tier icon and name

  • Player display name

  • Current Elo rating

  • Win / Loss record

If the authenticated user is ranked outside the top 10, their personal rank is displayed below the main list.

—

PvP Client (modules/arena/pvp-client.js)

PvPClient is the browser-side connection manager for the SSE stream.

const client = new PvPClient(user.uid, currentElo);

client.on('game_state', state => {
  renderPvPHUD(arenaRoot, { myHp: state.guestHp, oppHp: state.hostHp, ... });
});

client.on('match_end', result => {
  // Calculate Elo delta client-side, then POST to /api/arena/match/end
});

client.connect(roomCode); // Opens EventSource

Reconnection: exponential backoff starting at 1 s, doubling each attempt up to 30 s. Heartbeat: if no heartbeat event is received within 45 s, the client triggers a reconnect automatically.

—

Data Model (Firestore)

Collection: pvp_ratings

pvp_ratings/
  {uid}/
    displayName:  string
    elo:          number   (default 1200)
    wins:         number
    losses:       number
    lastMatchAt:  Timestamp

Writes use a batch commit (winner + loser in one atomic operation) via POST /api/arena/match/end to ensure the leaderboard always reflects consistent paired outcomes.
